IncidentDef.label: SCP-882 discovered
IncidentDef.letterText: An unusual mechanism has appeared. Keep metal away from it: anything left beside it may be consumed and turn into more machinery.

IncidentDef.label: SCP-106 breach
IncidentDef.letterText: The Old Man is phasing through barriers and corroding structures. Ordinary attacks cannot stop him. Use a built bait protocol station and select a volunteer to recapture him.

IncidentDef.label: strange doctor visit
IncidentDef.letterText: Three colonists lie wounded. SCP-049 has come to “help” them. He calls his work a cure for the Pestilence, but anyone he reaches may become a hostile ghoul. Keep him away from the wounded and fresh human corpses.
